entities.summary: Parthian, a notable figure in the history of Pakistan, associated with Indo-Greek, Kushan, and Gandharan Art (185 BCE–10). Preceded by Indo-Greek and Indo-Scythian Kingdoms. Their legacy influenced Kushan Empire and Kushan Empire and Gandharan Zenith.
